violations.why: The task reads v_lantern (line 23) while interrupt 1 is enabled; irq_meadow can pre‑empt, increment v_lantern (line 37), then the task continues and may write v_lantern (line 24).
After the task reads v_lantern (line 23), irq_meadow may fire, enable interrupt 2, and then irq_nectar can pre‑empt before the task writes (line 24), modifying v_lantern (line 15).
fn_saffron writes v_lantern (line 31) while interrupts are enabled; irq_meadow can pre‑empt, increment v_lantern (line 37), then the task later reads v_lantern (line 23) after disabling interrupts.
During fn_saffron’s write (line 31), irq_meadow may fire, enable interrupt 2, and irq_nectar can pre‑empt before the task later reads v_lantern (line 23).
